header.title: Open Field Studio
header.heroAlt: Open Field Studio: floor plan of an apartment with a numbered pin for each defect, coloured by status, and the list of tickets on the right
header.label: Inspection and handover
header.tagline: From a defect on the floor plan to a signed handover report, even without internet
header.desc: Pin every defect on the floor plan, work through a checklist and complete the handover with signatures on screen. On a laptop, an Android tablet or in the browser.

meta.description: Free, open-source app for inspections, handovers and quality assurance: defects on the floor plan, 15 checklists, a handover report with signatures and reports in PDF and BCF. For Windows, Linux, Android and the browser.
meta.title: Open Field Studio — OpenAEC Foundation

tickets.alt: Ticket for a missing sealant joint in the bathroom, with high priority, assigned to the installer and with a deadline
tickets.title: Every defect in the right place
tickets.desc: Click on the floor plan and record the defect with category, priority, severity, deadline and photos. Assign it to the contractor or installer and follow its status from open to verified.

inspect.alt: Energy label survey checklist with choice buttons for the dwelling type and fields for year of construction and floor area, 18 of 46 items filled in
inspect.title: A checklist for every inspection
inspect.desc: Choose from 15 ready-made checklists: building, installations, Wkb, underfloor heating, ventilation, energy label and monuments. Per item, fill in pass or fail, a NEN 2767 score, a measured value with its unit or a photo.

handover.alt: Pre-handover with ten tickets, each with a verdict of approved, conditional or rejected, and progress showing 7 of 10 assessed
handover.title: Hand over with a formal report and signatures
handover.desc: Go through all open items and approve them, approve them with conditions or reject them. Attach documents, let every party sign on screen and create the handover report. For the pre-handover, the handover and the follow-up inspection.

dashboard.alt: Dashboard with eleven tickets, five of them open and two overdue, charts by status, category and responsible party, and recent activity
dashboard.title: See at a glance what is still open
dashboard.desc: Counters for open, assigned, completed and overdue tickets, charts per category and per responsible party, and a log of everything that happened in the project.

report.alt: Export screen with the project overview, a choice of four reports and buttons for PDF, HTML, BCF and the project file
report.title: Reports for the client and the project file
report.desc: Create a project report, a list of open tickets, an inspection report or the handover report, as PDF or HTML, with photos and the marked-up floor plan. Or export the tickets as BCF for your BIM software.

connect.alt: List of connections, with ERPNext and n8n set up and able to import data
connect.title: Your file in your own systems
connect.desc: Fetch the client, contacts and drawings from ERPNext or through an n8n webhook, and send the project back automatically after saving or handover. For Woningborg, SWK, AFAS, Exact Online and Bouw7 there is a first connection with a test mode.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything for inspection and handover, in one app
features.sub: Start with the highlights, or pick a topic.

floorplans.title: Floor plans from PDF or image
floorplans.desc: Load a PDF, PNG or JPG. A PDF with several pages becomes one floor plan per page.

pins.title: Tickets on the floor plan
pins.desc: A numbered pin per defect, coloured by status. Filter by status, category and priority.

fields.title: Category, priority and severity
fields.desc: Eleven categories from building to safety, three priorities and four severity levels, with a deadline and a responsible party.

photos.title: Photos with time and place
photos.desc: Take photos with the camera or upload them. A new photo gets the time and, if you allow it, the GPS position, also in the report.

comments.title: Comments per ticket
comments.desc: Keep track of what was agreed for each ticket, with name and time.

templates.title: 15 checklists
templates.desc: Building, installations, safety, pre-inspection, Wkb, underfloor heating, ventilation, energy label and four for monuments.

nen2767.title: Condition score to NEN 2767
nen2767.desc: The checklists for monuments and installations score each item on the condition scale from 1 to 6.

inputs.title: Measurements, choices and photos
inputs.desc: A checklist item can be pass or fail, a choice, a number with a unit such as dm³/s or kPa, a text or a photo.

energy.title: Energy label survey
energy.desc: One checklist of 46 items for the dwelling, the envelope, installations, ventilation, renewable energy and photos.

monument.title: Monuments
monument.desc: Four checklists: structure and envelope, historic interior, moisture and damage, and the maintenance plan.

signing.title: Sign on screen
signing.desc: Inspections and handovers are signed with a finger or mouse, by each party separately.

verdict.title: Verdict per item
verdict.desc: Approved, conditional or rejected. Approved tickets are set to verified as soon as the handover is signed.

rounds.title: Pre-handover, handover and follow-up
rounds.desc: Each round with participants, notes and attachments such as measurement reports and warranty certificates.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and log
dashboard.desc: Tickets by status, category and responsible party, overdue deadlines and the latest activity.

reports.title: Four kinds of report
reports.desc: Project report, list of open tickets, inspection report and handover report, as PDF or HTML.

bcf.title: BCF for BIM software
bcf.desc: Export the tickets as BCF 2.1 with a photo per item, for BIMcollab, Revit or Solibri.

project.title: Project file
project.desc: The app saves everything automatically. Save the project as a single file and open it on another device.

ifc.title: View the 3D model
ifc.desc: Open an IFC model (IFC2x3 or IFC4) and orbit, pan and zoom through it.

bag.title: Address from the BAG
bag.desc: Look up the address by postcode and house number in the Dutch address and building register (BAG). You need your own API key from the Kadaster.

epol.title: Energy label from EP-Online
epol.desc: Fetch the registered energy label for the address, shown in the project and in the report. With your own API key from RVO.

erp.title: ERPNext and n8n, both ways
erp.desc: Import the project, client, contacts and drawings, and send the project file back to the linked project.

publish.title: Send the handover file
publish.desc: To Woningborg, SWK, AFAS Profit, Exact Online, Bouw7 or your own webhook, or push open tickets as tasks to KYP Project. With a test mode that sends nothing.

offline.title: Your data on your own device
offline.desc: No account and no cloud. The desktop and Android apps work without internet; you only need it for registers and connections.

languages.title: Four languages, light and dark
languages.desc: Dutch, English, German and French, with a light and a dark theme that follows your system.

download.title: Download v0.3.6
download.lead: Free, no account needed. For Windows and Linux, and as an app for Android.
download.browserNote: Rather not install anything? The app also runs in the browser.
download.label: Download
download.mobileNote: Open Field Studio is made for a large screen. Open it on your computer, or try it here in the browser.

backsync.title: Back to the project automatically
backsync.desc: When you save and after a handover, the project file goes to the linked ERPNext project or as a message to your n8n webhook.

import.title: Import a whole project
import.desc: Name, number, client, address, contacts and attachments from ERPNext in one go.

search.title: Search in the picker
search.desc: With more than eight projects, filter by name, number or client.

tab.title: A Connections tab of its own
tab.desc: All eight connections in one place, each showing whether it is set up.

desktop.title: Also with your own server
desktop.desc: The desktop app connects by itself, so a self-hosted ERPNext works too.

update.title: Notice of a new version
update.desc: A badge in the title bar as soon as a new release is ready.

whatsnew.label: New in v0.3.6
whatsnew.title: Connections that work both ways
whatsnew.desc: The 0.3 series gives connections their own tab. Fetch project data from ERPNext or n8n, and your work goes back to the linked project automatically.

files.a: Floor plans as PDF, PNG or JPG, IFC models (IFC2x3 and IFC4) in the 3D viewer, and Open Field Studio project files (.json). You take photos with the camera or upload them as images.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. The web version works straight away in the browser. If you want a separate app, download the installer for Windows or Linux, or the app for Android phones and tablets.

price.q: What does Open Field Studio cost?
price.a: Nothing. The app is free and open source under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, with no account or subscription.

save.q: In which format is my work saved?
save.a: The app saves everything automatically on your own device. With Save project you turn it into a single JSON file that you can open again on another computer. Reports export as PDF or HTML, tickets as BCF.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: Windows, Linux (.deb, .rpm and AppImage), Android phones and tablets (.apk) and any modern browser. There is no version for macOS or iOS yet.

practice.a: Yes. There are checklists for the Dutch Wkb basic check and for condition assessments to NEN 2767, addresses come from the BAG and energy labels from EP-Online. Tickets go to BIM software as BCF 2.1, and there is a first connection for Woningborg and SWK.

ai.q: What can an AI assistant do with it?
ai.a: Not much yet: there is no MCP server or API yet. You can use the project file (JSON) or an n8n webhook to pass data to other software or your own workflow.

offline.q: Does it work without internet on site?
offline.a: Yes, the desktop and Android apps do. Everything is on your device, including the PDF viewer, the 3D viewer and the fonts. You only need internet for the BAG, EP-Online and connections. The web version needs internet to open.

team.q: Can several people work on one project?
team.a: Not at the same time yet. Each device has its own copy. Share the project file, or keep it in one place through the ERPNext or n8n connection.

templates.q: Can I make my own checklists?
templates.a: Not yet. You choose from the 15 built-in checklists, or do a free inspection with your own observations.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: A small native app for Windows, Linux and Android, with native dialogs to open and save files.

vite.title: Vite and JavaScript
vite.desc: A lightweight interface without a large framework that works the same in the browser and in the app.

ifc.title: Three.js and web-ifc
ifc.desc: The 3D viewer reads IFC models with WebAssembly and only loads when you open its tab.

pdfjs.title: PDF.js
pdfjs.desc: Floor plans from PDFs are converted on your own device, without an external service.

idb.title: IndexedDB
idb.desc: Photos, floor plans and signatures are kept in the device's storage, so it does not fill up quickly.

i18n.title: i18next
i18n.desc: All texts in four languages, starting with the language of your system.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.
